title: Very cool mug
text:
Very cool mug. The mug is a very cool mug. There are no hairline cracks or any issues with the lettering. I really like the overall concept of the mug.
My only issue is that I think the lettering that says "Coolest person..." should be printed on the opposite side OR the writing underneath the mug should be flipped around. Otherwise when you tip the mug up the "Coolest person..." text has to face in toward the person so that the underside text reads properly.
Again, the concept is still cool though.
